notice: Derived extraction; authentication, transport envelopes and payload staging omitted. Original hash is in the disposition manifest. Device output is an observation, not proof of emitted light.

observations.command:
set -eu
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
readlink -f /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1
stat -c 'USB_NODE type=%F rdev=%t:%T mtime=%Y ctime=%Z' /dev/bus/usb/007/053
stat -L -c 'FD_TEST type=%F rdev=%t:%T' /proc/self/fd/0 /proc/self/fd/1 /proc/self/fd/2
for n in bInterfaceNumber bAlternateSetting bInterfaceClass bInterfaceSubClass bInterfaceProtocol; do
printf '%s=' "$n"
cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/"$n"
done
cat /proc/uptime
